3240-5631-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

280-1719-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-1719-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

967-2557-3809-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-2557-3809-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
3129-4094-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

751-1741-5778-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least 2 creatures with power 4 or greater.
751-1741-5778-6556.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries with offspring by paying {1}{U} using the cost reduction from Temur Battlecrier.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries abilities, untapping two lands.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the token copy of Cloud of Faeries enters, its ability triggers, untapping two lands.
Activate four lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake with offspring by paying {U}, using cost reduction from Temur Battlecrier.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries to its owner's hand.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
When the token copy of Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake to its owner's hand.
Repeat.
751-1741-5778-6556.notes: Once infinite mana has been generated, the Shrieking Drake can return any creature other than Zinnia to hand to recast infinitely.

215-1322-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-1322-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

877-3081-3817-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3587-6780-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3587-6780-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Your Temple Is Under Attack.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3587-6780-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

5003-5147-7283-7649.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
5003-5147-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

240-5231-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wispweaver Angel and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4785-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4785-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5900-5963-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5900-5963-7009.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Marvin.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-2511-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-2511-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

147-2171-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-5256.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2275-2541-6824.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

252-1251-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-1251-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1323-4667-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Elvish Aberration's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

759-1247-4221-5963-6549.description:
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2191-3090-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2781-4477-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
2781-4477-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Greenwarden of Murasa, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

1365-3263-4853-5256--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4853-5256--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1322-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1322-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1641-2034-4452-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

415-1162.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
415-1162.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Xathrid Demon triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Enforcer and causing each opponent to lose life equal to Angelic Enforcer's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

413-1447-2281.description:
Activate Saffi, targeting Angel of Glory's Rise.
Sacrifice Angel of Glory's Rise to Blasting Station to deal 1 damage to any target.
Saffi's delayed trigger returns Angel of Glory's Rise to the battlefield.
Angel of Glory's Rise's trigger returns Saffi to the battlefield.
Untap Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1385-2292-2781-2890-4681-4892.description:
Cast Flash, put Protean Hulk on the battlefield.
Hulk death trigger fetches Karmic Guide and Viscera Seer.
Karmic Guide reanimates Hulk.
Sacrifice Hulk to Viscera Seer, fetching Felidar Guardian and Zulaport Cutthroat.
Felidar Guardian triggers targeting Karmic Guide.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Viscera Seer, producing a Cutthroat trigger.
Flicker Karmic Guide targeting Felidar Guardian, return Felidar Guardian to the battlefield.
Repeat.
